It contains Methods and Results for the five studies, not merely an abstract or preregistration. No PDF supplied. Study 2 matches the supplied study and mismatching-article outcome, but the locator does not distinguish the model without covariates (printed t(137) = 2.42, beta = 0.20, p = .017) from the model with covariates (printed t(133) = 2.08, beta = 0.17, p = .039).
